entries.en: No, please. I'll do anything. I've got credits. Let me go and you can have them, all of them.
What's going on over here? Is this volus causing you some trouble, Commander?
Really? I think you'd better come with me.
I'll take it from here, Commander. Thanks for your help.
But the data! You don't know what you've done!
All right, save it for your lawyer.
If you say so. I'll be right over here if you change your mind.
Thank you. That was too close.
Oh, right. There you go. That's just about everything I've got.
All right, I will. I'll take it back to work and continue developing it there.
Thank you for not turning me in. I'll make the most of this second chance, I promise you.
Um... Commander? Would you be interested in helping me study the keepers?
Hello again. Did you have any luck finding Chorban?
But I didn't do anything to you!
Lying? Why would I lie to you?
What about the keeper data? We know about that.
Uh, he told you? I didn't mean for any of this to happen.
I was afraid Chorban would kill me to get the data, so I... well, I was hoping you'd take care of him.
This is serious, Jahleed. You could spend the rest of your life locked up.
I can't let this continue any further. I'm reporting what you did.
Tell me more about this data.
If it's that important, then take it back to the people it belongs to.
I can't let your actions go unpunished.
He's admitted to stealing data from his workplace.
Everything's okay, Officer. Thanks for asking.
Now you can return the favor by filling up my bank account.
Return the data or I'll have you arrested, right here, right now.
Have a nice day, Jahleed.
I killed him, and I've come back for you.
I found out you've been lying to me, Jahleed.
You're in trouble.
You idiot!
I'm turning you in.
Explain.
Then do it legally.
Take it back!
We're fine.
Payment.
Oh, it's you. Did you change your mind? Do you have time to help me now?
I just want someone to talk to my colleague. He's been acting strange and I think he wants to kill me.
What did you need?
No thanks.
Why won't anyone believe me?
I'm not leaving until somebody looks into this.
Some scientists can be very dangerous.
Well, good luck.
What about the keeper data?
You forgot to mention the data about the keeper.
What about the data? You did not mentioned that before.
You lied to us about the keeper data.
It's a bit late to be thinking about that.
Too late, volus. You had your chance.
You should've thought of that sooner.
It's a shame, but you should have considered the consequences before you acted.
Yes. I'll help you.
Well, I thought I'd ask. So long.
Just take this scanner. Every time you see a keeper, scan it.
Whenever you get a unique scan I'll reimburse you. That's it.
Good luck, and so long.
What do you need me to do?
You're... you're helping us? But... well, if you say so.
Well, if Chorban can forgive and forget, then so can I.
I appreciate the help, Commander. I better go get that data analyzed.
Chorban? That's the guy who asked us to scan the keepers.
Chorban? Isn't that the salarian who asked us to scan the keepers?
Chorban? Wasn't that the salarian who asked us to scan the keepers?
Chorban? That's the guy who wanted us to scan the keepers.
The keepers? Well... even more reason to go after him. That's against regulations.
Anything's possible with Chorban these days.
I'm scanning the keepers for Chorban. But you two need to stop fighting.
I'd better look into this right away. Find out what he's up to.
If I find out he's lied to me....
We're in this together.
Relax. I'm helping out.
Leave it to me.
That's a serious claim.
Definitely.
He didn't make it.
Can't help you right now.
Sorry, Commander. I'm just waiting for a report from my supervisor.
Been to Flux's yet?
Okay, Jahleed. Let me get this straight. Your business partner... Chorban. He's threatened you?
Well, no, not exactly. But he wants to meet with me. I think he's going to kill me.
And why do you think that?
I-- I can't really get into the details. But Chorban will kill me if I leave here unprotected.
I can't help you. Not unless you give me something more to go on.
I-- I can't. I'm sorry.
Then I've got other work to do.
But--
But nothing! Don't bother me unless you're willing to give me details.
Detective Chellick. Come into my office. I want to discuss this in private.
Sorry, Commander. Nobody's allowed on the Normandy right now. Doing some routine maintenance.
Sorry, Commander. The Normandy's locked down. Ambassador Udina gave the order.
